comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
After reaching Rank 2 of Commercial Battle License, you can obtain this by giving away 500 Merits to get one. According to JP wiki, here's the list of Reward (you get one of these randomly) :

2x Navy Dispatch Request
3x Patriot Award
5x Renegotiation Demand
2x Stomach Medicine
Banner of the Lion Heart
Essay on Navigation
Shipwright's Emergency Repair Tools
Headache Medication
3x Purchase Order Collection

While some from the lists are confirmed obtainable in Maris, the others could be removed/swapped to something else. But yes still need confirmation and need to be checked later. Thanks to Wsp for the correction~
